decisions.reason: Locating the master power control on the front panel does not change simultaneous-load capacity, power-supply sizing, controller capacity, or overload protection.
The control-location decision does not change the prototype's standard 120V wall power source.
The source specifies where the power button or switch could be placed, but does not necessarily change any BOM component selection or documentation obligation.
The functional power-control placement does not alter the established DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative-control styling.
Adding a centered front-panel power control does not necessarily change the placard text, its placement on both sides, or its viewing orientations.
The power control is positioned relative to dispense buttons, but the source does not change spout geometry, material, mounting location, or orientation.
The front-panel location of the master power control has no entailed effect on splash targets or mitigation measures.
The power-control placement does not change the unit's stability, vibration behavior, base, or feet.
Message 142 does not address spout removability, flushing, or cleaning; the later cleaning discussion cannot be propagated from this source Event.
Referencing the two dispense buttons as positional landmarks does not change their dispensing behavior, valve mechanism, sequence, or flow constraints.
The source establishes only power-control placement and does not specify or alter any body, accent, base, or font color.
The front-panel power-control location does not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
